content.short: Envelop is a cross-chain toolkit delivering collateral-backed NFT functionality, price discovery, and liquidity.
content.description: Envelop is a flexible cross‑chain toolkit that unlocks new functionality for any NFT. It supports architectural features like economic set‑ups, on‑chain royalties, rental mechanisms, and time/value/event locks, enabling creators and projects to program more sophisticated behavior directly into tokens. It also provides protections against devaluation and fraud, helping assets stay secure across chains. In the longer term, Envelop aims to enable cross‑chain tokenization of payment channels to unlock idle liquidity and pave the way for secured decentralized derivatives.
